run_maml_omniglot_training: run the MAML few-shot Omniglot classification training script with configurable n-way k-shot parameters
train_maml_meta_learning: train a meta-learning model using MAML with inner loop gradient steps on support sets
test_maml_few_shot: test the MAML model on few-shot classification tasks without additional fine-tuning
plot_maml_accuracy: plot training and test accuracy curves over epochs and save to maml-accs.png
create_functional_net: create a functional neural network using functorch make_functional_with_buffers for MAML meta-learning
